releaseWorkflow.scope: Pinned selected-source calibration, using repository compiler configuration where present. Does not install or execute sample applications.

experiments.decisions: Candidates require source-context review. No scores in this document are applied to evidence or gates.

sourceReview.provenance: Original review run IDs retained. Reuse across fresh runs requires identical revision, handler identity, location, and source hashes.
sourceReview.interpretation: Source-context counterexamples and unresolved review questions; unknowns are not labeled defects. No runtime correctness claim.
